text:
Asking rents in Brunswick stand at a median of 9.78 €/m² (2026-06), down 0.1% on the year and +16.5% over five years. That ranks Brunswick #28 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 34% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.27 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 587 € a month in cold rent, 12.7% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 29 days and 24% are gone within a week; with 2.3% market-active vacancy and +1.5% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.22 €/m² (+4.5%), with an 80% range of 9.98 to 10.56 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
